content:
maria: Rolling v4.3.1 to eu-west in the 01:00 UTC window. Canary 10% at 01:05. Watch p95, 5xx, embedding cosine drift, and synthetic heartbeats. Release notes link: https://releases.redwood.ai/4.3.1

jamal: ack. traffic tag `v4-3-1-canary` created. fallback pinned to v4-3-0 if needed.

deploy-bot: canary_start triggered by @maria at 01:05 UTC. canary_id=canary-2026-12-01-01. 10% -> v4-3-1-canary. Monitoring hooks enabled.

slo-bot: ALERT: embedding-drift-eu-west crossed threshold at 01:09 UTC. avg cosine delta +0.11 (threshold +0.08).

olivia: pulling eval diffs. Looks consistent across pricing-related prompts. Might be tokenizer or embedding layer change.

sree: quick smoke for generation: OK, p95=140ms, 5xx_rate=0.05%. Embeddings show shift on sample IDs 210/999.

jamal: tracing shows no infra errors. I can apply route-level pin for embeddings while keeping other routes on canary. Shall I?

maria: yes pin `embeddings:*` to v4-3-0 for eu-west. Hold full ramp. Notify product.

jamal: applied pin: POST /v1/routing/pins {"routes":["embeddings:*"],"pin_to":"v4-3-0","scope":"eu-west"} - success.

deploy-bot: canary paused at 10% (quality gate fail).

maria: triage suggests tokenizer bump introduced accidentally. Jamal open hotfix PR to revert tokenizer change. Keep pin live until hotfix canary proves stable.

jamal: PR opened: https://git.redwood.ai/r/3789. CI running. Tagging `urgent:embedding-regression`.

olivia: SLO snapshot scheduled at 02:00 UTC will include this window; suppress embedding-drift alerts for pinned routes. I'll add note to release page.

sree: will re-run smoke against hotfix canary once CI passes.

maria: thanks team. If customers escalate, route to #customer-success and add note to the release notes. We'll reconvene at 02:15 UTC to decide next steps.
